# Related Backblaze B2 sample applications

The [`backblaze-b2-samples`](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples) and [`backblaze-labs`](https://github.com/backblaze-labs) organizations contain practical applications that complement these reference architectures. The projects below demonstrate robot log offload, dataset streaming, simulation output, mapping, training and event patterns on B2. The [Backblaze Labs catalog](https://backblazelabs.com/) lists more.

## Closest workflow matches

<!-- catalog:samples-workflow:start -->
| Sample | What it demonstrates | Most relevant here |
|---|---|---|
| [Rosbag2 Cloud Offload](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/rosbag2-cloud-offload) | A watcher presigned-PUTs each closed rosbag2 split to `bags/<robot>/<session>/` while recording continues, deletes local copies only after head_object confirms them, describes sessions from metadata.yaml into a Parquet catalog, and replays sessions from a presigned GET manifest. | [robot-log-offload](../architectures/robot-log-offload/architecture.md), [fleet-search-replay](../architectures/fleet-search-replay/architecture.md) |
| [LeRobot B2 Streaming](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/lerobot-b2-streaming) | Records LeRobot v3 episodes to B2 under one prefix per episode and streams them back to N workers by ranged-GETting only the Parquet row groups and MP4 byte windows each episode needs. | [teleop-imitation-datasets](../architectures/teleop-imitation-datasets/architecture.md) — Its per-episode prefix layout differs from the versioned `datasets/<name>/<version>/` layout recommended here |
| [MuJoCo Rollout Dataset](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/mujoco-rollout-dataset) | Rolls out MuJoCo Playground policies, renders each episode to video, and writes the video plus per-step state, action, and reward arrays and a summary JSON to B2 for behavioral cloning and offline analysis. | [sim-rollout-datasets](../architectures/sim-rollout-datasets/architecture.md) |
| [KISS-ICP LiDAR Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/kiss-icp-lidar-archive) | Ingests LiDAR scan frames, runs KISS-ICP odometry and mapping on the backend, and archives scans, poses, point-cloud maps, and trajectories per session over the S3-compatible API. | [mapping-session-archive](../architectures/mapping-session-archive/architecture.md) |
| [Open3D Point Cloud Pipeline](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/open3d-point-cloud-pipeline) | Ingests PLY, PCD, LAS, and LAZ scans into B2, then downsamples, registers, meshes, and renders them, writing every artifact and a JSON job manifest back to B2. | [mapping-session-archive](../architectures/mapping-session-archive/architecture.md) |
<!-- catalog:samples-workflow:end -->

## Operational building blocks

<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:start -->
| Sample | Reusable pattern |
|---|---|
| [Roboflow Inference Frame Archive](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/roboflow-inference-frame-archive) | Runs Roboflow Inference on each frame on-device and archives only flagged detections (the JPEG frame, its prediction JSON, and an hourly Parquet roll-up) to B2. The pattern for event-triggered capture on robots. |
| [DuckDB Query In Place](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/duckdb-query-in-place) | Runs SQL directly against Parquet, CSV, and JSON in B2 with DuckDB httpfs and materializes results back to B2 as Parquet. The pattern behind querying the session catalog in place. |
| [B2 Event Broker](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-event-broker) | Forwards B2 Event Notification messages to multiple subscribers, such as a describe or catalog job that runs when a bag split arrives. |
| [WebDataset Streaming PyTorch Training](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/webdataset-streaming-pytorch-training) | Packs media into .tar shards on B2 and streams them back into PyTorch as an IterableDataset with no local staging disk and a distributed worker and node shard split. |
| [Ray Train/Tune checkpoints notebook](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/notebooks/tree/main/ray-train-tune-checkpoints) | Notebook that configures Ray Train and Tune persistent storage on B2 and writes checkpoints there. |
| [HF Cache Sync](https://github.com/backblaze-labs/hf-cache-sync) | Syncs the local Hugging Face cache to B2 or S3 so machines and CI share one copy of base model weights instead of repeating hub downloads. |
| [Mountpoint for S3 CSI driver with B2](https://github.com/backblaze-b2-samples/b2-integration-mountpoint-csi) | Uses the AWS Labs Mountpoint for Amazon S3 CSI driver with B2 so Kubernetes pods can mount a bucket read-mostly, for sim assets and training data that jobs expect as file paths. |
<!-- catalog:samples-building-block:end -->

## Selection guidance

- Select a sample based on the required workflow and data formats.
- Keep key design, retention, Object Lock and boundary decisions in this repository's architecture documents.
- Where a sample's prefix layout differs from an architecture's recommended layout, the architecture page says so.
- Configure authentication, tenant isolation, scoped credentials, retention, and recovery for the deployment.
